T: The Ministry lies. The snacks don't.
D: Harry forms a secret group of students to fight back while the Ministry takes over Hogwarts.
P: Serve the snacks when Dumbledore's Army meets in the Room of Requirement.
S: the Hog's Head pub where Dumbledore's Army forms
Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with English mustard, like a dusty village pub.
Fred and George's fireworks wrecking Umbridge's exam
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter and coloured sprinkles, with popping candy scattered over just before serving.
Umbridge's pink office full of kitten plates
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with very pink buttercream and topped with a little sugar flower.
M: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
the Order meets at Number Twelve
Rich steak and kidney in gravy under a golden puff pastry lid. Brown 800g diced chuck and 200g lamb kidney, add an onion, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml beef stock and Worcestershire and simmer 2 hours.
dinner under the floating candles in the Great Hall
Chicken rubbed with butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with crispy roast potatoes, peas and gravy from the pan.
W: Shortcrust filled with warmed golden syrup, fresh breadcrumbs and lemon zest, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, served warm with cream.
K: the jugs on every Hogwarts table
Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, strained and chilled.

s.note: Fred and George's fireworks wrecking Umbridge's exam
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Toss with 60g melted butter and a big handful of coloured sprinkles. Scatter popping candy over just before serving so it crackles like a joke shop firework display.

s.note: Umbridge's pink office full of kitten plates
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter and icing sugar with pink colouring and pipe on top. Finish each with a little sugar flower.

m.n: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
m.note: the Order meets at Number Twelve
m.how: Brown 800g diced chuck and 200g lamb kidney, add an onion, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml beef stock and Worcestershire and simmer 2 hours. Spoon into a dish, cover with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Warm 400g golden syrup with 100g fresh breadcrumbs and the zest and juice of a lemon, then pour into the case. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until just set. Serve warm slices with a pour of cream.

d.note: the jugs on every Hogwarts table
d.how: Roast 300g butternut pumpkin until soft and cool completely. Blend with 1L apple juice, a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Strain into a jug, chill well and pour into goblets over ice.
